bias.en: Bearish · broke the September and October lows
bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 9 月和 10 月低点

read.en: Teradyne fell 10.6% on Oct 22 to $308.75, trading between $306.84 and $323.88 on 2.3 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($330.3), 10-day ($352.1), 30-day ($378.0) and 100-day ($379.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($347.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($381.08), and RSI is 33.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 10月22日下跌 10.6%，收于 $308.75，盘中区间 $306.84–323.88，成交量为平均水平的 2.3 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$330.3）、10 日（$352.1）、30 日（$378.0）和 100 日均线（$379.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$347.1）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$381.08），RSI 为 33。

read.en: The drop broke $341.5, $332, $326 and $322.3 and closed just under the $309.4 May 19 low. Resistance is $309.4, then $322.3–326.4 (Oct 20 low, September lows) and $330.3–332 (5-day, Oct 15 low). Support is $306.8 (Oct 22 low), then $301–301.9 and $296.8 (spring and July lows). A close below $301 would open $296.8; a close above $309.4 would target $322–326.
